# Allowlist for deploy/bin/live_drift_check.py (EB-103, 2026-10-21): files in ~/.local/share/vllm-qwen27b that are
# not installed from git, or whose drift is expected. Read from the git ref being checked, so changes are reviewed.
#   ignore <glob>  never compared: runtime state, logs, locks, banked copies, retired launchers
#   local <glob>   host-local by policy ("code public, config private", Kevin 2026-10-21): private host config and
#                  secret carriers; never compared, never in git (redacted examples: deploy/env/host-local/)
#   report <glob>  compared and printed, but drift does not fail the check
# Everything else in the live directory must come from git by install.sh's mapping, or the check fails.

# Runtime state, logs and locks written by the gateway, the actuator, the watchdog and the model switcher
ignore *.lock
ignore *.pid
ignore *.log
ignore *.jsonl
ignore *.out
ignore active-serve
ignore diag.env                     # written by engine-actuator.py
ignore gateway-stats.json
ignore gateway-spend.json
ignore gpu-busy.json
ignore liveness-*.json
ignore model-switch.previous.json
ignore offline-*.json
ignore planned-restart.last.json
ignore recorded-fault.last.json
ignore remote-dead-until.json
ignore remote-pricing.json
ignore restart-job.json
ignore retention-*.json
ignore spend-reconciliation.json
ignore watchdog-state.json
ignore wedge-restart.last.json
ignore window-active.json

# Host-local by policy: secret carriers, and host config that names the network, clients, paths and models.
# Redacted examples are in git (deploy/env/shim.env.example, deploy/env/host-local/*.example*).
local shim.env
local gateway-aliases.json
local admin.token
local clients.map
local lanes.dirs
local MODEL-SWITCHING.md
local v02.override.env               # edited live by GPU windows and by hand
local v02.model.json                 # written by model_switch.py

# Banked copies of earlier versions, kept by hand for rollback
ignore *.bak*
ignore *.pre-*
ignore *.staged-*.py
ignore *.BANKED-*
ignore *.before-*
ignore *.bootstrap-*
ignore serve-tqk8v4-fg.sh.*

# Stray test copies from before install.sh stopped shipping test_* (2026-10-03); the repo keeps the real ones
ignore test_*.py

# Retired launchers from the August 2026 0.1.x experiments: never in git, not on the production path
# (production: vllm-qwen27b.service -> serve-active.sh -> active-serve -> serve-hauhaucs-v02.sh)
ignore serve-ab-on.sh
ignore serve-ab-off.sh
ignore serve-abliterated.sh
ignore serve-burst-a.sh
ignore serve-burst-b.sh
ignore serve-forensic-eager.sh
ignore serve-inst.sh
ignore serve-k16-verify.sh
ignore serve-k8chain.sh
ignore serve-mtp-test.sh
ignore serve-patched-test.sh
ignore serve-PROFILE-copyburst.sh
ignore serve-small-8002.sh
